title: cityPack provenance.jsonl row v0.1
description: Schema for one row of a pack's provenance.jsonl (one JSON object per line). Per-field provenance is mandatory (hard rule): every geometry element in a pack has a provenance row with WHO + WHEN + LICENSE + synthesis_tier. Reuses PROV-O / London Charter paradata norms; not a novel format.

row_id.description: Stable id of this row, referenced from manifest.json entities as 'provenance.jsonl#<row_id>'.

entity_id.description: Identifier(s) of the entity this row attests. Must match the entity's id overture/osm/wikidata in the manifest.

who.description: Person or organization responsible for the attestation / reconstruction of this element (PROV-O Agent).

when.description: ISO 8601 date, date-time, or year (negative years allowed for BCE) when the attestation / reconstruction was produced.

license.description: License under which the source / output is released, e.g. 'CC0', 'CC-BY-SA 4.0', 'public domain', 'BnF Gallica non-commercial'.

synthesis_tier.description: Mandatory honesty field, must match the synthesis_tier declared on the corresponding manifest element.

source.description: Optional pointer to the upstream source (media/ path, URL, archive reference).

method.description: Optional short description of the reconstruction method used (DUSt3R-from-photo, procedural+diffusion, direct import, etc.).
